title: Natural Science Exhibition
content: Last Friday we visited the Focus on Nature exhibition at theNew York State Museumin Albany.This exhibit happens every two years, and brings together the work of over 70 natural science artists from 13 countries.The artwork shows plants, insects, mammals, and amphibians, and is primarily executed in watercolor, colored pencil, and digital.It was fun to meet the other artists, and we went upstairs in the museum to see the collection of jury award winning paintings from previous years.Focus on Nature websiteFollow the link to download the PDF of the catalog(23MB) with samples of artists's work and statements.
